entry.title: Knight & Dragon IV
entry.content:
Discount Information（Price：$3.99 → $1.99 [$1.99 ~ $3.99]）

All Price Information

Price：$1.99

Application Description

Rare drops! Class changes! And an epic story. The 4th installment of the hardcore Hack & Slash RPG "Knight & Dragon," packed with replay value! "Knight & Dragon 4" is the fourth title in this Hack & Slash RPG series built within a medieval fantasy world. The story takes place about 30 years prior to the events of the previous game, III. The setting is the "Hundred Years' War" between the great Lindar Empire and the Kingdom of Langheim, one of the Eldorua kingdoms. The journey begins in a refugee camp located near the border of these two great powers. In a world swirling with conspiracy, people from all walks of life are swept up in the chaos of war. The stories of their respective knights and dragons eventually converge toward a single conclusion. Enjoy an epic narrative featuring characters from previous titles. [Features of Knight & Dragon 4] * Heated Real-Time Battles: The core systems of a "replayable RPG," such as rare item drops and class changes, follow the beloved formula of previous titles! * Expanded Party Size: You can now battle with a party of 6 members. Time pauses while selecting commands, allowing for more intuitive control! * Deep Strategic Gameplay: With new systems like "Formations" and "Skill Chaining," the battle system is more refined, offering even more depth and replayability! * New Jobs Added: With the addition of the "Beast Tamer" and "Gladiator," there are now 8 jobs in total. New skills have also been added to complement existing jobs! * Revamped World: A completely renewed world map to color the epic story. Of course, post-game content is included! * Legacy Content: Many characters from the previous game appear, with significant text additions that supplement the scenarios of the past titles! * Classic Features: Popular basic functions from the previous game, such as Party Dispatch, Persona functions, and Equipment Enhancement/Customization, are all here! ... If you would like to experience the atmosphere of the game before purchasing, the previous title "Knight & Dragon" is available completely free of charge, so please give it a try. Official Website http://dgjam.com/knightdragon4

Application Description

Survive in endless dungeons by connecting blocks to attack, defend, and heal. Dungeon Tracer is a roguelike puzzle RPG that combines strategic turn-based combat with dungeon exploration. Connect identical blocks to unleash powerful sword attacks, shield defenses, and life-saving potions. Your decisions each turn shape the outcome of battles and your survival. ■ Recommended for - Players who enjoy puzzle RPGs and roguelikes - Fans of turn-based strategy combat - Those seeking offline dungeon adventures - Gamers who love crafting new builds and strategies through replay ■ Core Gameplay - Connect blocks to attack, defend, and heal - Every turn's choice impacts your strategy - Combo effects grow stronger with longer connections - Embrace the roguelike challenge where death means starting anew - Develop survival strategies in ever-changing scenarios ■ In-Depth Strategic Combat Experience the blend of intuitive block connection puzzles and the tactical depth of roguelike RPGs. Your play style varies with block placements, enemy types, skill selections, and item combinations. ■ 10 Classes and 10 Races Each class features unique skills and traits. Combine these with racial traits for diverse builds. Experiment to find your ideal strategy. ■ Diverse Skills and Builds Mix over 40 active skills and growth elements to create your unique combat style. Each skill and item choice leads to different outcomes. ■ Special Monsters and Block Debuffs Face 43 unique monsters, including liches, avengers, kamikazes, and assassins. Block debuffs like freeze, fire, poison, and lock can turn the tide of battle. Simply connecting blocks won't guarantee victory. ■ Fair Roguelike Challenge A seed-based deterministic random system ensures consistent results in each run. Enjoy a challenge where strategy and judgment outweigh luck. ■ More Fun with Repeated Growth Skill choices evolve with each level-up Builds focus on upgrades and items Dungeons reconfigure with each playthrough A structure where a single mistake heightens the tension ■ Global Leaderboard Compete with players worldwide. Test your skills against global rankings and showcase your best scores. ■ 4 Difficulty Levels Choose from Easy, Normal, Hard, and Very Hard Enjoyable challenges for both newcomers and veterans. ■ Premium Offline RPG - No ads - No in-app purchases - Enjoy offline play Once purchased, access all content fully. ■ Support for Multiple Languages and Cloud Save Supports 22 languages, ensuring you can continue your adventure seamlessly across devices. Endless dungeons await, filled with powerful monsters and strategic choices. How long can you survive? Experience the depth of puzzle roguelike RPGs in Dungeon Tracer today!

Wall of Insanity is a new project from the creators of the Slaughter game series. It features a dark storyline, intense action, and a mystical journey into a dead, smoldering world. You will face the unknown. A descent into a kingdom of anxiety and madness. The path through the abyss will be difficult, the trek extremely dangerous, and you will be left almost hopeless. Story: A police operation to detain a dangerous cult's sectarians leads to unexpectedly deadly consequences. That squad vanished under mysterious circumstances, and the Special Unit soldiers sent in to investigate their disappearance find just an empty, abandoned house. This is only where the story begins... Key Features: - Active battles with the use of firearms. Survival depends on caution, reaction speed, and weapon accuracy. Use elements of the environment itself to escape this horrific world. - A journey to another world where fear, sorrow, and madness rule. A diligently crafted, ominous environment, fraught with mystery and danger, lies ahead of you. How far will you dare to go? - A plethora of traps and enemies await around every corner. Investigate your surroundings carefully. Don't take unnecessary risks. Study your enemies. Carefully selected tactics will save your ammunition. And your life. - Explore the world to replenish and expand your arsenal. Weapons and useful items will be needed. Look for secrets, documents, and workarounds to prevail against all odds. - Wall of Insanity features simple controls, gamepad support, good optimization, and a wide graphics customization.

Application Description

Build the dungeon. Set the traps. Wait for the heroes. Skel & Defense is a dungeon defense roguelike where you play the villain. Expand your dungeon room by room, fill it with deadly traps, transform into Skel, and stop wave after wave of heroes coming for your treasure. Combine the strategy of tower defense with the replayability of a roguelike, and build a dungeon no adventuring party can survive. ◆ Become the Dungeon Master, Not the Hero Every dungeon has a monster waiting in the darkness. This time, that monster is you. At night, expand your dungeon and prepare your traps. During the day, defend the gates against waves of invading heroes. Build, defend, improve, and repeat. Turn a humble underground tomb into an unstoppable fortress. ◆ 26 Trap Rooms, Countless Combinations Build and combine 26 unique trap rooms, including fireballs, lava zones, freezing mist, icicles, saw blades, poison arrows, electromagnetic fields, and more. Combine rooms of the same element to unlock powerful synergies. Freeze enemies before burning them alive. Trap them in narrow corridors and finish them with poison. Your dungeon layout determines how long the heroes survive. ◆ Transform into Skel and Fight Traps are not your only weapon. Transform into different Skels and fight the invaders yourself. Become a Mage Skel and launch fireballs from the rear, a Rogue Skel throwing shurikens, or a Shield Skel holding the front line. When your traps are not enough, finish the job yourself. ◆ 7 Stages, Endless Mode, Global Rankings Conquer 7 stages with different rewards, then enter Endless Mode and face increasingly powerful waves. How long can your dungeon survive? Register a nickname in the options menu to join the global rankings and compete with players around the world. ◆ Over 30 Perks, A Different Run Every Time Choose from more than 30 perks during each stage. Take powerful upgrades to strengthen your build, or accept dangerous penalties in exchange for bonus score. Focus entirely on traps, strengthen your Skel, or combine both approaches. Every run is different, and every decision matters. ◆ Grow Stronger with Every Run Defeat waves to earn Trait Points and unlock permanent upgrades that make future runs stronger. Explore the Collection to uncover hidden synergies, new rooms, and powerful relics. There is always one more strategy to discover. ◆ Full Controller Support Prefer playing with a controller? A different ending. ■ Unique Heroes — Not just different stats. A completely different way to play. Assassin: Double damage to a single target. Pick one. Make it count. Engineer: Stack shields, then unleash devastating area attacks. Defense is offense. Gambler: Free level-up rerolls. When luck becomes strategy. Noble: +1 level-up choice, gold-powered leveling at shrines. Money is your weapon. …Every hero demands a different strategy. ■ Diverse Skill Cards — Not collection. Combination. Your deck is your strategy. Chain Lightning: Hit up to 3 enemies in a chain Double Cast: Trigger the same skill twice in a row Replicate: Copy any card in your deck on the spot Skill grades: Common → Rare → Epic → Legendary Upgrade cards mid-combat and discover powerful combinations. ■ Powerful Relics — Sometimes a single relic changes everything. Chalice: Revive once with 50% HP upon death Shard of Collapse: For the next 3 battles, all non-boss enemies start with 1 HP Shackles of Binding: +1 mana per turn, but shop prices increase by 25% Sanctuary Lantern: Fully restore HP whenever you enter a shop ■ Distinct Enemies — Every battle is a new puzzle. Read the pattern or die. Treasure Goblin: Escapes after 7 turns if you fail to defeat it Snowman: Freezes you for 1 turn Crow: Forces you to discard a random card from your hand Face powerful bosses with unique attack patterns and multiple phases. ■ Seal System — The real challenge starts here. Normal mode is only the beginning. As you unlock more Seals, increasingly brutal challenges await. Combine Trials and Contracts to design your own difficulty. Only a handful of players will conquer the hardest combinations. ■ Challenge Mode — New rules. New competition. Every week. Face rotating Grand Pacts and Trials each week. Discover powerful builds under unfamiliar rules where old strategies may no longer work. Compete with other players for the highest score and climb the weekly rankings. Clear the final region of a Challenge to unlock Endless Battle. How long can you survive against enemies that never stop growing stronger? ■ Endless Replayability 3 regions × 11 floors — procedurally generated every run Battle, Event, Elite, Shrine, Shop — diverse room types Different maps, enemy combinations, and card rewards every time Even with the same hero, no two adventures are alike. ■ Features Turn-based strategy + deckbuilding roguelite Unique heroes, skills, relics, and enemies Seal System — customize difficulty with Trials and Contracts Challenge Mode — weekly rules and competitive rankings Endless Battle — push your limits against endless enemies Procedurally generated dungeons Multiple languages supported Cloud save Tear the dungeon apart with your own strategy. One run is never enough.

Make wallpapers, widgets, and watch faces with your photos, text, emoji, and stickers. Create something for your own screens or share it with friends. MAKE IT YOURS Start with a photo, a gradient, stripes, or a solid color. Turn photo cutouts, words, and emoji into stickers. Choose fonts, colors, outlines, and finishes, then move, resize, rotate, and layer your stickers. WALLPAPERS, WIDGETS, AND WATCH FACES Make wallpapers for iPhone and iPad or choose custom dimensions. Create Home Screen widgets with a separate layout for each size. Export your artwork as an Apple Watch face. Use your saved stickers in Messages, too. CREATE AND SHARE Send an image, share an editable copy, or invite friends to a shared creation. Choose who can view or edit. Friends can join for free. ADD MOVEMENT AND TEXTURE Create Live Photo wallpapers with animated sticker effects. Try finishes including chrome, holographic, glitter, embroidery, and risograph, and preview animations as you work. KEEP YOUR COLLECTION WITH YOU Keep your creations and sticker library across your devices with iCloud. Search for artwork by what its images show, explore guides and ideas, and use Shortcuts to create and work with your designs. DECO PLUS Start free with up to three wallpapers, two widgets, and ten saved stickers. Unlock more with Deco Plus, available as a one-time purchase. Every price option includes the same Plus features. If you bought Deco before version 3.0, you keep your paid access.
